articles.origTitle: One dead and another missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada

articles.title: Portugal: Cristiano Ronaldo announces his international retirement
articles.summary: Portuguese football legend Cristiano Ronaldo announced on Thursday he was retiring from international football at the age of 41.

articles.title: Analysis of Historical Uranium Cubes Explains Failure of German Atomic Program
articles.summary: Examinations of historic uranium blocks indicate that Germany's wartime nuclear initiative collapsed due to mathematical misjudgments. Researchers concluded that physicist Werner Heisenberg severely underestimated the total volume of elements necessary for success.
articles.origTitle: Uranium cubes reveal why the German nuclear project failed
articles.origSummary: "Our calculations suggest Heisenberg significantly underestimated the materials required."

articles.title: VMware Launches vSphere Express to Support Smaller Hardware Setups
articles.summary: VMware has introduced vSphere Express to accommodate virtualization needs on systems with up to 128 cores. Company executives stated the product responds directly to feedback from smaller clients.
articles.origTitle: VMware releases vSphere Express for virtualization on up to 128 cores
articles.origSummary: “We started listening to a lot of our lower-end customers," VMware exec says.

articles.title: AMD Posts Record Revenue as Data Center Sales Surge Past Gaming Losses
articles.summary: AMD reached a record $13.4 billion in quarterly revenue, driven by a doubling of its data center division. Meanwhile, the company's gaming sector experienced a 40 percent drop.
articles.origTitle: AMD's record quarter: Data center business doubles, while gaming craters
articles.origSummary: AMD's gaming revenue fell 40 percent in an otherwise record $13.4 billion quarter.

articles.title: Silicon Valley attributes voter opposition to AI as pro-Trump sentiment
articles.summary: Major technology firms argue that recent American voter initiatives limiting artificial intelligence and data infrastructure stem from political alignment rather than tech hostility.
articles.origTitle: Big Tech claims voters’ AI backlash is “anti-Trump” not “anti-tech”
articles.origSummary: Tech industry in denial as US overwhelmingly votes to restrict AI, data centers.

articles.title: SpaceX and Elon Musk face new outlook following Texas election results
articles.summary: Following Democratic victories in Texas, discussions emerged regarding the future trajectory of Elon Musk and his aerospace enterprise SpaceX.
articles.origTitle: After Texas' blue wave, what happens to Elon Musk and SpaceX?

articles.title: Over 600,000 march across France over living expenses
articles.summary: Crowds exceeding 600,000 people demonstrated across multiple French cities demanding government intervention for rising living expenses, with mostly peaceful gatherings despite sporadic clashes.
articles.origTitle: France: More than 600,000 protest as anger grows over cost of living
articles.origSummary: Demonstrators took to the streets in several French cities to call for government action on the high cost of living. Protests were largely peaceful, but there were some reports of escalation, including in Paris.

articles.title: Lyft's new subscription bundles in DoorDash's DashPass for $10 per month
articles.summary: As reported by Engadget, DashPass members can get Lyft Go at no extra cost. Key points: Lyft, Door, Dash, Lyft Go.
articles.origTitle: Lyft's new subscription bundles in DoorDash's DashPass for $10 per month
articles.origSummary: DashPass members can get Lyft Go at no extra cost.

articles.title: Sony launches MDR-3R wired headphones featuring 1979-inspired design
articles.summary: Sony has introduced the MDR-3R, a new set of wired headphones that utilizes a vintage aesthetic. The product's appearance is based on a design originally released by the electronics company in 1979.
articles.origTitle: Sony's MDR-3R wired headphones are steeped in retro aesthetics
articles.origSummary: Sony has refreshed a headphone design that dates back to 1979.

articles.title: Meta releases Instagram Edits video editing application for Mac
articles.summary: The video editing tool from Meta, known as Edits, is now available as a desktop application for Mac users. The software, which competes with platforms like CapCut, currently has a user base exceeding 50 million people.
articles.origTitle: Instagram's Edits is now on desktop as a Mac app
articles.origSummary: Meta's CapCut competitor already has more than 50 million users.
